```yaml
name: Security Audit and Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  safety-hardening:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      
      - name: Run cargo fmt check
        run: cargo fmt --check
      
      - name: Run cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
      
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo test --lib
      
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: cargo test --all
      
      - name: Build release version
        run: cargo build --release
      
      - name: Apply patch for CORS policy
        run: sed -i 's/CorsLayer::permissive()/CorsLayer::new().allow_origin("https://example.com")/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Apply patch for API token auth
        run: sed -i '/fn handle_request/ s/$/ if !request.headers().contains_key("Authorization") { return HttpResponse::Unauthorized().finish(); }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Apply patch for structured consent target validation
        run: sed -i '/fn validate_consent_target/ s/$/ if is_public_suffix(target) || is_private_ip(target) { return Err(ValidationError); }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Apply patch for replay DNS rebinding fix
        run: sed -i '/fn handle_dns_rebinding/ s/$/ let resolved_ip = resolve_ip(ip); if resolved_ip != ip { return Ok(resolved_ip); }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Apply patch for insecure TLS runtime warnings
        run: sed -i '/fn handle_tls/ s/$/ if !is_secure_tls(tls) { warn!("Insecure TLS detected"); }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Apply patch for CSRF protection
        run: sed -i '/fn handle_post/ s/$/ if !is_csrf_token_valid(token) { return HttpResponse::Forbidden().finish(); }/' src/main.rs

  detection-quality:
    needs: safety-hardening
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      
      - name: Run benchmark
        run: ./target/release/waf-detector --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json
      
      - name: Expand cross-provider negative evidence
        run: sed -i '/fn expand_negative_evidence/ s/$/ for group in 43..=43 { add_group(group); }/' src/main.rs

  va2-maturity:
    needs: detection-quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      
      - name: Apply patch for symmetric content-length delta
        run: sed -i '/fn calculate_content_length_delta/ s/$/ let delta = content_length1 - content_length2; if delta == 0 { return None; }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Apply patch for challenge taxonomy
        run: sed -i '/enum ChallengeType/ s/$/ { ConfidenceScore f32; }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Add async VA2 job endpoints
        run: echo "async fn handle_va2_job(start: String, status: String, cancel: String) -> Result<(), Error> { /* implementation */ }" >> src/main.rs

  trust-productization:
    needs: va2-maturity
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      
      - name: Apply patch for SecurityPosture metadata
        run: sed -i '/struct DetectionResult/ s/$/ { SecurityPosture posture; }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Apply patch for deterministic VaReplayBundle
        run: sed -i '/fn create_vareplay_bundle/ s/$/ let hash = md5(data.as_bytes()); VaReplayBundle { data, hash };/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Enforce token auth and reject insecure TLS in prod mode
        run: sed -i '/fn handle_request/ s/$/ if env::var("WAF_DETECTOR_MODE").unwrap_or_else(|_| "dev".to_string()) == "prod" { if !request.headers().contains_key("Authorization") { return HttpResponse::Unauthorized().finish(); } if !is_secure_tls(tls) { return HttpResponse::Forbidden().finish(); } }/' src/main.rs
      
      - name: Add operator-facing caveats
        run: echo "fn handle_caveat(detection: DetectionResult) -> String { match detection.posture { SecurityPosture::BodyOnly => \"Body-only detection\", SecurityPosture::TimingDominant => \"Timing-dominant detection\", SecurityPosture::InsecureTLS => \"Insecure TLS detection\", _ => \"No caveat\" } }" >> src/main.rs
```
